security_audit.summary: The skill is useful browser automation documentation, but it encourages attaching automation to real authenticated browser state. Critical profile and session reuse risks are confirmed, while most Markdown fence detections are false positives. No prompt injection text was found.

remediation.suggestion: Remove personal profile paths and CDP instructions for logged-in profiles. Require isolated profiles and explicit user consent for authenticated sites.
Replace star-swap.com examples with neutral placeholders. Add warnings to stop before account changes or credential entry.
Pin package or repository versions, explain trust boundaries, and require confirmation before running global installs or dependency installers.
Document safe use for eval, cookies, storage, upload, screenshots, and PDFs. Require review when pages may contain sensitive data.

content.user_title: Automate Browser Tasks with Agent Browser
content.value_statement: Manual browser workflows are slow and hard to repeat. This skill gives agents structured commands for navigation, interaction, extraction, and screenshots.
actual_capabilities: Navigate pages with open, back, forward, reload, and wait commands.
Click, type, fill, select, check, and drag page elements.
Capture snapshots, screenshots, PDFs, page text, HTML, and attributes.
Use named sessions, headed mode, and CDP connections when configured.
Return machine-readable snapshots for agent planning workflows.
limitations: Requires the external agent-browser CLI and browser dependencies.
Does not bypass authentication, CAPTCHA, permissions, or site rate limits.
Snapshot refs can change after navigation, reloads, or dynamic page updates.
Real browser profiles can expose cookies and sessions; use isolated profiles.

use_cases.title: Run UI Checks
use_cases.description: QA engineers can navigate pages, click controls, fill forms, and verify visible states with repeatable snapshots.

use_cases.title: Collect Web Evidence
use_cases.description: Researchers can capture titles, page text, screenshots, and PDFs from authorized pages for review.

use_cases.title: Drive Agent Workflows
use_cases.description: AI agent operators can use JSON snapshots and stable refs to plan browser actions step by step.

prompt_templates.title: Open and Inspect
prompt_templates.prompt: Open the target URL, take an interactive snapshot, and summarize the main actions available on the page.

prompt_templates.title: Complete a Form
prompt_templates.prompt: Open the target page, fill the requested fields, show the entered values, and wait for my confirmation before submitting.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Visible Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Navigate to the target page, collect title, key text, and a screenshot, then explain which elements were used.

prompt_templates.title: Automate a Session Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use an isolated session to complete the specified workflow, verify each step with snapshots, and stop before destructive actions.

output_examples.input: Open the pricing page and compare plans.
output_examples.output: The agent opens the page, captures a snapshot, selects the pricing area, and returns plan names with visible prices.

output_examples.input: Fill the contact form but do not submit it.
output_examples.output: The agent fills requested fields, reports the values, and waits for explicit approval before submitting.

output_examples.input: Capture evidence from a dashboard page.
output_examples.output: The agent records the page title, key visible metrics, and screenshot location for the authorized session.

best_practices: Use isolated browser sessions and temporary profiles for all authenticated work.
Capture a new snapshot after every navigation or page reload.
Ask for confirmation before submitting forms, uploading files, or changing account settings.
anti_patterns: Reusing a personal Chrome profile without explicit consent.
Opening hardcoded third-party sites when the user supplied a different target.
Running eval, cookie, storage, or upload commands on untrusted pages without review.

faq.question: Does this skill install the browser tool?
faq.answer: It provides installation commands, but the user or agent must run them with consent.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it bypass login or CAPTCHA?
faq.answer: No. Users must provide authorized access, and manual challenges still require human action.

faq.question: Does it support screenshots and PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented CLI can capture screenshots and PDFs when the command is available.

faq.question: Are browser sessions persistent?
faq.answer: Named sessions can persist cookies. Use isolated sessions and clear them when work is complete.

faq.question: Is using a real Chrome profile safe?
faq.answer: It is risky because cookies and sessions may be exposed. Use a temporary profile instead.
